subject.title: fix(workspace): prevent false Missing labels on existing files and fix panel layout overlap

question: Should `sessions.files.list` ever expose existence, size, and mtime for transcript-mentioned paths outside the fs-safe workspace root?
rationale: The PR's visible UX goal is reasonable, but the current implementation changes a read-scoped Gateway security boundary rather than only changing rail presentation.

options.title: Keep fs-safe metadata boundary
options.body: Remove the raw stat fallback and fix the rail by filtering, hiding, or neutral-styling external entries behind the existing workspace boundary.

options.title: Split the layout fix
options.body: Carry only the CSS-safe portion if still needed and leave external-file semantics to the canonical workspace rail issue.

options.title: Accept external metadata deliberately
options.body: Allow the metadata leak only with explicit maintainer security acceptance plus protocol, UI, and upgrade tests documenting the contract.

recommendation.title: Keep fs-safe metadata boundary
recommendation.body: Remove the raw stat fallback and fix the rail by filtering, hiding, or neutral-styling external entries behind the existing workspace boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently carried the current fs-safe workspace file boundary and related rail stabilization on main.
